patches.before: 書庫そのものに錠を付けるようなもの。錠を開けられない人には、棚の書類が 1 冊も読めない。
patches.after: 書庫を丸ごと大きな金庫にしてしまうようなもの。金庫ごと運び出されても、開けられない人には棚の書類が 1 冊も読めない。

patches.before: 就像给整个书库装上一把锁。打不开锁的人，连架上的一份文件都读不到。
patches.after: 就像把整个书库做成一个大保险箱。即使连保险箱一起被搬走，打不开的人也连架上的一份文件都读不到。

patches.before: It is like putting a lock on the archive room itself. Anyone who cannot open the lock cannot read a single document on its shelves.
patches.after: It is like turning the whole archive room into one big safe. Even if the safe is carried off, anyone who cannot open it cannot read a single document on its shelves.

patches.before: An authority is always a third-party body.
patches.after: If the name says “authority”, it is a third-party body.
